name: Record
designer: MUST NOT implement or instantiate; only handle schemas (DAT-004) exchanged as JSON.
runtime: MUST create records via RecordBuilderFactory (DAT-016) and pass them unchanged between components.

name: Record.Builder
runtime: MUST call `build()` once per record; SHOULD provide a schema for predictable output; name collisions are auto-renamed (DAT-013).

name: Record value access and coercion
runtime: MUST use typed accessors matching `Entry.getType()`; SHOULD use `getOptionalXxx` for nullable entries.

name: Schema
designer: MUST be able to read the Schema JSON returned by schema-discovery actions and MAY store it as design-time schema of a connection.
runtime: MUST treat schemas as immutable value objects; MUST create them via RecordBuilderFactory (DAT-016).

name: Schema.Type
designer: MUST map each constant to a UI/column type and to the host's internal type system.
runtime: MUST support all 11 constants in the host record model (or convert losslessly, see DAT-031 for Avro).

name: Schema.Entry
designer: MUST display name, type, nullable and comment; SHOULD show rawName as label when present.
runtime: MUST keep name/rawName pairs intact across components.

name: Schema.Entry.Builder
runtime: SHOULD set `nullable` explicitly (builder default is false).

name: Schema.Builder
runtime: MUST build RECORD schemas through the factory (DAT-016) so the host-selected implementation (memory or Avro, DAT-034) is used.

name: Schema.EntriesOrder
designer: SHOULD display columns using the order given by `getEntriesOrdered()` / prop `talend.fields.order`.
runtime: SHOULD preserve the order property when copying/transforming schemas.

name: OrderedMap
runtime: MAY reuse when implementing a custom Record/Schema; otherwise none.

name: SchemaProperty
designer: SHOULD honor `field.key`, `field.size`, `field.scale`, `field.pattern`, `field.origin.type` when showing or mapping schemas.
runtime: MUST preserve props when copying entries; SHOULD NOT invent semantics for unknown keys.

name: SchemaProperty.LogicalType
designer: SHOULD render DATE/TIME/TIMESTAMP with the matching widget/format.
runtime: MUST keep `field.logical.type` when converting to/from Avro.

name: SchemaCompanionUtil (name sanitization and collisions)
designer: MUST use `name` (sanitized) as the technical identifier and MAY show `rawName`.
runtime: MUST NOT rely on original field names for lookups; use `Entry.getName()`.

name: Entry-level error support
designer: MAY display invalid cells using the entry props.
runtime: MAY set the system property; SHOULD check `entry.isValid()` before reading and MUST NOT treat invalid entries as data.

name: Nullable check switch
runtime: SHOULD leave the default; MAY set true for performance in a trusted environment.

name: RecordBuilderFactory
runtime: MUST provide it as an injectable service to every plugin container (ComponentManager does by default).

name: RecordService
runtime: MUST provide it as a built-in service when hosting TCK plugins with a custom container; SHOULD reuse `RecordServiceImpl`. The injected instance MUST be backed by the plugin's `RecordBuilderFactory` and JSON-B.

name: RecordVisitor
runtime: SHOULD implement RecordService.visit to support it; not needed otherwise.

name: RecordPointer
runtime: MUST implement with the semantics of DAT-020 if RecordPointerFactory is provided.

name: RecordPointerFactory
runtime: SHOULD provide the reference semantics (RFC 6901 adapted to records). MUST inject a factory scoped to the plugin.

name: Deprecated schema API (service.schema.Schema and Type)
designer: MUST still accept schemas returned by legacy components (same JSON shape).
runtime: none

name: @FixedSchema
designer: MUST NOT let the user edit the schema of the listed flows; MUST re-call the action when a `watch` path changes.
runtime: none

name: Component data type conversion (Record / JsonObject / POJO)
runtime: MUST convert non-Record values to Record before handing data to the engine (as `InputImpl.next()` and `BeamOutputEmitter` do); SHOULD standardize on `Record`.

name: JSON-P / JSON-B mapping of Record
runtime: MUST use a Johnzon-compatible JSON-B/JSON-P provider with the settings above when it produces JSON from records; MUST decode BYTES as Base64.

name: Avro mapping (Beam runtime)
runtime: MAY use the Avro implementation; if used, MUST run with `talend.component.record.skip.sanitize=false`; MUST NOT mix implementations inside one plugin.

name: Schema JSON serialization (SchemaConverter)
designer: MUST serialize a chosen schema with these keys when a component option is of type `Schema`.
runtime: MUST accept this JSON in the option value.

name: Type conversion rules (MappingUtils.coerce)
runtime: MUST reproduce these rules if the host supplies its own Record implementation; SHOULD reuse `RecordImpl`.

name: RecordBuilderFactoryProvider SPI
runtime: MAY provide one implementation per JVM; MUST make it return Serializable factories (they serialize as SerializableService).

name: Metadata entries
designer: SHOULD hide metadata entries from the default column list and expose them separately.
runtime: MUST NOT drop metadata entries when copying records.

name: Arrays and nested records
designer: MUST handle ARRAY/RECORD entries (render nested, or flatten) when propagating schemas.
runtime: MUST handle nested types in transport and conversion.
